annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Directive 2014/15/EU of 18 October 2013 amending Annex IV to Directive 2011/65/EU as regards an exemption for lead, cadmium and hexavalent chromium in reused spare parts recovered from medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Directive 2014/15/EU of 18 October 2013 amending Annex IV to Directive 2011/65/EU as regards an exemption for lead, cadmium and hexavalent chromium in reused spare parts recovered from medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 4/73 (9.1.2014)
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Delegated Directive amending Annex IV of the RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU to exempt lead, cadmium and hexavalent chromium in reused spare parts from medical devices used in category 8 equipment, under closed-loop B2B systems with consumer notification. Not related to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds point 31 to Annex IV of RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU
Exempts lead, cadmium and hexavalent chromium in reused medical device spare parts
Reuse must occur in auditable closed-loop B2B return systems
Reuse of parts must be notified to the consumer
